accepted.construct: const x = e | let x = e | let x

accepted.limits: one level, no default, no rest

accepted.construct: x = e | local.x = e | local.o.k = e

accepted.lowering: item read as current in its own body; when a nested construct rebinds current and reads the outer item, copy it to local.item at the start of the outer body; one-level destructured fields are copied from current.field

accepted.construct: for (let i = a; i < b; i++) {…}
accepted.limits: < or <=, step ++, i not assigned in the body, no continue in body; maxIterations 1000000
literal labels, every case ends with break/return/throw, default last

accepted.lowering: error = local.e (local.error without parameter); e read inside catch only

accepted.where: e is the parameter of the enclosing catch, not assigned

accepted.construct: xs.toSorted((a, b) => a.k - b.k) | xs.toSorted((a, b) => a - b) | localeCompare on matching item keys or the items themselves | [...xs].sort(…)

properties.by: current.k for a key comparator; omitted for an identity comparator (the block uses current)

accepted.note: compare is a new list.sort property: a copy sorted by the engine's Array.prototype.sort with the arrow's comparator (stable; NaN compares equal); without compare list.sort keeps its Flow order

accepted.lowering: one node per block step, linked by local.__chain<N>
accepted.where: assignment or return; not in a branch of ?: && || ??, not in an expression function argument, not after a scope read of the statement

accepted.lowering: expression function default (null, undefined and "" replaced)

accepted.where: properties beyond the JavaScript form; slots keep $$ keys

accepted.construct: // text or /* text */ above a statement, no blank line
accepted.lowering: node comment (formatter writes // lines); standalone comment node after a blank line

accepted.construct: function helper({ a, b }) { … } after the Flow function, called helper({ a: 1 })
accepted.lowering: helper block, as in v2; body under the same rules

refused.construct: import … from "…"
declaring or importing flow, a scope name, or a local starting with __
a local named like a block namespace the Flow uses (text, list, json…)
x and local.x in the same Flow
a name read outside the block that declares it
refused.rewrite: declare it in the enclosing block

refused.construct: a name declared again in an enclosed block, or hiding an import or a loop variable
assigning a const
destructuring with default, rest or nesting
x++ or x += e inside an expression
result.x = … and return { … } in the same Flow
break
refused.rewrite: a local tested by the while condition, or find / filter

refused.construct: finally
return inside a loop
refused.rewrite: continue, or a local and a return after the loop

refused.construct: a for (;;) other than for (let i = a; i < b; i++)
switch with fall-through, non-literal case or default not last
do … while, for … in, labelled loop, labelled break or continue
a function other than a top-level helper, a list arrow or a slot: nested, in an expression, a closure
refused.rewrite: inline, a top-level helper, or a project block

refused.construct: a block method in a branch of ?: && || ??, in an expression function argument, or after a scope read of the statement
xs.sort alone, another comparator, reduce, (x, i), outer arrow parameter in an inner arrow
refused.rewrite: toSorted, list.sum, list.map or a loop

refused.construct: const rows = [] then rows.push
refused.rewrite: json.array({ itemType }) with the type of the pushed values

refused.construct: Object.* or JSON.* elsewhere or with other arguments, Object.entries, Date.now, new Date
throw new Error(m)
async, await, generators, classes, this, new
if or while whose condition is an object literal

valueRules: paths are null-safe (undefined instead of a TypeError)
<, <=, >, >= compare two numeric texts as numbers
a template literal writes null and undefined as "", objects and lists as JSON
loops have an execution budget: while 1000 passes and 60 s unless flow.while sets other bounds; counted for 1000000 passes

rendering.default: natural JavaScript form wherever the meaning is identical, call form otherwise; author forms kept through __flowScript* node fields

names.loopVariable: item, then item2, item3… when visible

conformance.why: Rhino 1.9.2 keeps the first value of a const declared in a block nested in a loop (#326); v3 lowers each declaration to an assignment at every pass
conformance.rule: run by the Flow engine from the lowered tree, never by evaluating the text with Rhino; no const is rewritten
